policy: 本地科研绘图采用固定风格预设，避免不同线程临场发挥。默认正式科研图使用社科版 Nature 莫兰迪风格；真实数据图仍由确定性工具控制数值。图名和长图注不进入图片内部，元素重叠必须检查。

presets.label: 社科版 Nature 莫兰迪正式科研图
presets.style_role: 默认正式科研图风格。吸收 Nature 式层级、留白、细线条和出版感，但改造成社科论文可用的概念、机制和研究设计图风格。

constraints: Use low-saturation Morandi colors rather than random vivid colors.
Use at most two accent colors in one figure.
Do not default to plain black-and-white except when a target journal requires it.
Check grayscale readability as a safety test, not as the default aesthetic.

typography.font_policy: Formal manuscript figures prefer serif fonts with Chinese Songti/SimSun fallback and English Times-style fallback. Presentation use may use a modern sans-serif only if all labels stay consistent.
rules: Keep visible text short; long explanation belongs in the caption or manuscript text.
Panel labels use consistent size and position.
Do not place formal figure titles inside the image.
All generated text must be checked and repaired if misspelled.

line_style: Use slightly stronger line weight only for the central path.
Avoid heavy borders, shadows, glass effects and 3D outlines.
arrow_style: Arrows must express real flow, causal hypothesis, process order or conceptual dependence.
Use one arrow style per semantic relation.
Dashed arrows are reserved for feedback, uncertainty or indirect links.
panel_layout: Organize multi-panel figures as descriptive fact, main result, mechanism or heterogeneity, robustness when applicable.
Each panel must answer one distinct question.
Use generous spacing between modules and panels.
Do not create a decorative collage.
legend_rules: Use shared legends when a legend is necessary.
Prefer direct labels when they reduce cognitive load.
Legends must not cover lines, points, arrows or text.
whitespace_rules: Use high whitespace as part of the style.
Leave enough margin around all labels, arrows and modules.
Do not compress dense labels into small boxes.
title_caption_policy: Do not put the formal figure title inside the image.
Do not put a long caption inside the image.
Put title, caption, data source, sample, model, note and script path in manuscript text or delivery notes.

required_phrases: white-background social-science journal figure
low-saturation Morandi color palette
no figure title inside the image
no long caption inside the image
no overlapping text, legend, arrows, points or lines
all text must be readable and spelled exactly as provided
no invented data, axes, p-values, sample sizes, citations or sources

overlap_checks: Text must not overlap modules, arrows, panel labels or other text.
Legends must not overlap lines, points, confidence bands or arrows.
Arrowheads must not touch labels or pass through text.
Panel labels must not collide with axes, legends or content.

presets.label: Nature 社科版真实数据图
presets.style_role: 默认真实数据图风格。保持出版级克制和高级感，但所有数值、坐标、误差条和显著性必须来自确定性代码或可复现输出。
source_inspiration: scientific-figure-skill data health and process data discipline

constraints: Use low-saturation Morandi colors as the default empirical palette.
Do not encode meaning by color alone; add line type, marker shape, facet or direct label when useful.
Keep confidence intervals and uncertainty readable.
Do not use image2 to create empirical values, axes, p-values or sample sizes.

typography.font_policy: Formal empirical figures use serif fonts by default; axis labels 10 pt, ticks and legends 9 pt, panel labels 10 pt.
rules: Axis titles must include quantity and unit when applicable.
Tick labels must not overlap or rotate into unreadability.
Legends must not cover plotted data.
No internal formal title; use external caption and manuscript text.

line_style: Use thin reference lines and slightly heavier main estimate lines.
Confidence intervals should be visible but not visually dominant.
Avoid heavy box borders unless target journal requires them.
arrow_style: Use arrows sparingly in empirical figures.
Annotations must point to real plotted evidence.
Do not imply causal direction without the manuscript design supporting it.
panel_layout: Keep axis ranges comparable across panels unless a note explains otherwise.
Separate heterogeneous estimates by facet or panel rather than cluttering one axis.
legend_rules: Place legends above, below, or in an empty margin when possible.
If a legend overlaps a line, point, confidence band or bar, move it or use direct labels.
Shared legend is preferred for multi-panel figures.
whitespace_rules: Reserve margin for labels and legends.
Do not let confidence bands, annotations and legends compete for the same space.
Use tight layout only after checking overlap.
title_caption_policy: No formal figure title inside the plotting area.
No long caption inside the image.
Caption must be delivered as text with unit, sample, time window, model, uncertainty, source and script path when available.

required_phrases: layout assistance only
low-saturation Morandi color palette
no figure title inside the image
no long caption inside the image
no overlapping legend, labels, points, lines, bars or confidence intervals
do not invent or change any data values, axes, p-values, sample sizes or sources

overlap_checks: Text labels must not overlap axes, tick labels, legends, plotted data or annotations.
Legends must not overlap plotted data.
Axis labels and tick labels must not collide.
Annotations must not cover confidence intervals or points.
Panel labels must not overlap axes or plot marks.

presets.label: 投稿审稿安全莫兰迪风格
presets.style_role: 投稿和审稿阶段默认保守风格。它保留低饱和色彩和高级感，但优先服务审稿可读性、证据边界、图注完整和可复现。
source_inspiration: local peer review and submission package gates

constraints: Use low-saturation Morandi colors as the default review-ready palette.
Use fewer colors than the formal research preset.
Keep all elements legible in grayscale.
Avoid decorative effects and visual flourish.
Never remove uncertainty, source, model or sample information for visual simplicity.

typography.font_policy: Use manuscript-safe serif fonts and keep font sizes stable across all submitted figures.
rules: All labels must survive PDF review zoom levels.

line_style: Use patterns or direct labels when grayscale may collapse colors.
arrow_style: Use arrows only when necessary for interpretation.
Avoid curved decorative arrows in review figures.
panel_layout: Panel order follows the manuscript evidence sequence.
Keep panel labels consistent across the submission package.
Do not introduce a new visual grammar only for one revision figure.
legend_rules: Legends should be shared and outside the data-dense region.
If space is tight, use direct labels or split panels.
No legend may overlap plotted marks or text.
whitespace_rules: Use enough white space for reviewer annotation.
title_caption_policy: No long note inside the image.
Caption text must carry source, sample, model and uncertainty.

required_phrases: review-ready social-science journal figure
low-saturation Morandi palette
no figure title inside the image
no long caption inside the image
no overlapping visual elements
no invented data, sources, axes or citations

overlap_checks: All text must remain legible after PDF export.
Legends and notes must stay outside dense plotted regions.
Panel labels must not collide with figure marks.

presets.label: 研究汇报高级莫兰迪风格
presets.style_role: 答辩、汇报和研究展示图风格。允许更强层级和视觉冲击，但仍遵守数据真实性、无重叠和图名图注外置原则。

constraints: Use low-saturation Morandi colors as the default presentation palette.
Use stronger scale contrast than manuscript figures but keep low saturation.
Do not turn research figures into marketing posters.
Keep the figure compatible with manuscript-grade reconstruction if needed.

typography.font_policy: Presentation figures may use modern sans-serif for screen readability, but manuscript exports must keep the serif fallback option.
rules: Use larger text for screen readability.
No long caption inside the figure.
Do not use decorative typography that weakens academic clarity.

line_style: Allow subtle hierarchy through line weight.
arrow_style: Dashed arrows indicate feedback or optional paths.
panel_layout: Use strong visual hierarchy and generous margins.
Make the central claim legible at slide scale.
Keep each panel aligned to the story sequence.
legend_rules: Use legends only when the audience needs repeated symbol decoding.
whitespace_rules: Use whitespace to create a premium publication feel.
Do not fill every corner of the canvas.
Keep hierarchy obvious at a glance.
title_caption_policy: Slide title belongs to the slide, not inside the figure asset.
Figure caption or speaker note belongs outside the image.
Do not place long explanatory paragraphs inside the visual.

required_phrases: premium social-science research presentation figure
low-saturation Morandi palette
white or warm-white background
no figure title inside the image
no long caption inside the image
no overlapping text, legend, arrows, points or lines
all labels exactly as provided
no invented empirical values, citations or sources

overlap_checks: Text and callout labels must not overlap modules, arrows or large visual blocks.
Large labels must not overlap modules.
Callouts must not cover the central flow.
Legends must not hide evidence or arrows.
